text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon, thank you again for the
supplements!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right. Well? Did they help your eye
fatigue?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes! By the next day, I was able to read
the book
I'd been dying to finish.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Any other changes? Any muscle
spasms,
increased blood circulation, or
fits of ecstasy?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all! I actually felt more
relaxed than
normal. It was like all my
stress just disappeared...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just what is in those supplements? I'm
sure it took
a long time to come up with
the current formula.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah, no, those supplements were
created for
a previous body modification
experiment of mine,
so—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Training is already so stressful on its
own. I can't
believe you're also studying
medicine on the side!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any tips for efficient
studying? I'd
love to hear them if you
do!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh... What an intriguing response. Heh...
You're
quite the dangerous one, if I do
say so myself.
